theorem: Unitary frame changes reduce the displayed non-diagonal unital channel to a Pauli channel with probabilities p. Pauli twirling preserves its recovery objective, so the full CPTP recovery SDP reduces to max_{q in simplex} p dot q. The primal vertex q_X=1 attains 41/100 and the dual scalar y=41/100 satisfies y>=p_i, proving zero duality gap. Conjugating the X correction back by the two supplied SO(3) frames gives the displayed laboratory-basis unitary recovery.
